description: This file defines a custom adapter class for a WearableRecyclerView in an Android application, managing a dataset of strings and handling item selection via a controller.

classes.name: CustomRecyclerAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView adapter for displaying a list of strings in a wearable device, with click handling to notify a controller.

classes.name: CustomRecyclerAdapter.ViewHolder
classes.description: Holds references to the views for each item in the RecyclerView, specifically a TextView.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new ViewHolder by inflating the item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder and sets click listener to notify controller.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the size of the dataset.
